newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed prices up on shortcovering.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed prices up on shortcovering.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices gained on Tuesday to 1,151/1,152 rupees per quintal from 1,144/1,145 rupees on shortcovering, dealers said.
"Overseas buying remained low but shortcovering by bear operators helped the market to bounce back," one dealer said.

June delivery rose from 1,214/1,215 rupees to 1,221/1,222 rupees in concert but volumes were nominal. New crop arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region fell on Tuesday to 25,000/30,000 bags (75 kg each) against 40,000/42,000 bags on Monday.

Groundnut oil was steady at 342/343 rupees per 10 kg on limited arrivals and stray seasonal support. Imported palm oil was quiet at 280/281 rupees per 10 kg. Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 510/515 rupees per 15 kg.
